 WATCH: Ikram Alikhil takes a stunning diving catch to dismiss Ben Curran on Day 3 of ZIM vs AFG 2nd Test
 Published - Nov 16, 2026, 08:30 UTC | Updated - Nov 16, 2026, 08:20 UTC by Ekansh Rastogi Verified Ikram Alikhil produced a brilliant diving effort behind the stumps to help Mohammad Saleem Safi dismiss Ben Curran.
 Zimbabwe maintained a strong position against Afghanistan with a 291-run lead at stumps on Day 3 in Sharjah.
 Ikram Alikhil takes a stunning diving catch to dismiss Ben Curran on Day 3 of ZIM vs AFG 2nd Test (Pic Source: X.com) Table of Contents
 Ikram Alikhil pulls off a brilliant diving catch Here’s the video 
 Zimbabwe hold a commanding lead against Afghanistan on Day 3 
 Afghanistan wicketkeeper Ikram Alikhil pulled off a spectacular diving catch during the second Test against Zimbabwe at the Sharjah Cricket Stadium. The wicketkeeper showed excellent reflexes and athleticism to grab a sharp outside edge off Mohammad Saleem Safi’s bowling, giving the visitors an important breakthrough in the second innings.
 The dismissal brought an end to Ben Curran’s stay at the crease after he had scored 19 off 40 deliveries. Safi, who had been one of Afghanistan’s most impressive seamers across the two Tests, celebrated passionately after his effort was rewarded with a wicket.
 Ikram Alikhil pulls off a brilliant diving catch 
 The dismissal took place in the 13th over of Zimbabwe’s second innings when Safi bowled a fuller delivery just outside the off stump. Curran, who had been troubled by a short ball from the pacer on the previous delivery, attempted to defend but failed to keep the ball away from the wicketkeeper.
 The ball took a healthy outside edge and travelled towards the first-slip region. Ikram reacted quickly, dived full stretch to his right and managed to grab the ball just in front of the slip fielder. It was an excellent effort from the wicketkeeper, while Safi ran away in celebration after picking up the breakthrough.

 Also WATCH: Ziaur Rahman Sharifi takes a brilliant catch to dismiss Wessly Madhevere on Day 1 of AFG vs ZIM second Test 
 Zimbabwe hold a commanding lead against Afghanistan on Day 3 
 Zimbabwe had posted 339 in their first innings, with veteran batter Brendan Taylor leading the way with a brilliant 119. Opener Innocent Kaia also made a valuable 96, while Brad Evans added an unbeaten 32 at the end. Afghanistan debutant Naseer Khan Maroofkhil was the standout bowler, claiming seven wickets for 151 runs.
 In reply, Afghanistan were bowled out for 217, giving Zimbabwe a 122-run first-innings lead. Wicketkeeper Afsar Zazai top-scored with 63, but Vincent Masekesa’s four-wicket haul and Blessing Muzarabani’s three scalps helped the visitors take control. Zimbabwe then reached 169/7 at stumps on Day 3, extending their overall lead to 291 runs despite a late collapse.
